digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend unit test suite
propositions: Data Center backend has no value-level unit test coverage; only shape assertions exist in test_backend_contract.py, whereas Cloud's test_backend_characterization.py pins values for priority map, status map, sanitizer boundaries, identity labels, and probe branches

DC create-path mapper _map_local_to_dc_fields must be pinned by value for every key it emits: summary, description, issuetype, priority, status, assignee, including defaults and empty-string fallbacks, with no project key emission
DC sanitizer boundaries for summary, description, and comment must be pinned at-limit and one-over, with exact truncation suffix marker verification
Shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote must be exercised through WikiTextCodec, pinning description truncation at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT, non-str pass-through, and isinstance guard behavior

DC probe branches must pin all four classifications (PRESENT_RESOLVED, PRESENT_FILTERED, ARCHIVED_OR_MOVED, UNREACHABLE) via real classify_probe_response or JiraDataCenterTransport, not through FakeTransport stub
DC probe must bind its own configured resolved_statuses (not Cloud's), verified with non-default custom set to prove discriminator works across different status sets
